newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sharp to build a second LCD plant at Mie, Japan.
newsitem.headline: Sharp to build a second LCD plant at Mie, Japan.

text.p: Sharp Corp said on Tuesday that it will build a second liquid crystal display (LCD) plant at its complex in Mie prefecture, central Japan.
It said the new plant should start production in October 1998.
Besides the Mie complex, Sharp currently produces LCDs at two other plants in Japan, the Sharp spokesman said.
Sharp said that the size of world's LCD market is expected to reach 1.5 trillion yen in the fiscal year from April 1, 1999, about 2.2 times larger than in 1996/97.

Demand for large LCDs, used for notebook and desktop personal computers and workstations, is expected to grow to 12.5 million units in 1999/2000, an increase of 4.5 times over fiscal 1996/97, Sharp said.
